question: Will Tesla deliver between 475000 and 500000 vehicles in Q3 2026
rationale: Structural cross-venue inconsistency on the same Tesla Q3 2026 delivery announcement (resolves Oct 2). Live Kalshi KXTSLA-26OCTDELIV ladder (17:5xZ Sep 29): Above-470k 0.69/0.70 and Above-500k 0.12/0.18 are both tight, so even at the Kalshi quotes most favourable to PM, P(475k-500k) <= 0.70 - 0.12 = 0.58; the ladder midpoint (Above-480k 0.32/0.39, Above-450k 0.88/0.89) puts it near 0.40-0.45. PM Yes bid is 0.70, above that hard bound. Independent anchor below both venues: sell-side consensus Visible Alpha 449-454k, Bloomberg 463-466k, median of six banks 458k (JPM 482k, Barclays 475k, UBS 470k, StoneX 446.5k, GS 435k, Cantor 421.8k; Electrek 2026-09-28); Aug US sales -26pct y/y and China retail -12.4pct y/y. Kalshi has drifted from ~480k mid-Sep to low-to-mid 470s while the PM bracket did not follow. Own P(Yes) 0.45 is deliberately shaded toward PM for the Street's 74k low miss on Q2 and a Troy Teslike number I could not find. Outside-view check (claimed edge >0.10): the named fact is the Kalshi executable bound, not disagreement with the price. Sibling 450-475k Yes (ask 0.18, own 0.32) left forecast-only, one leg per event.
